newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's OMV to enter local gas market.
newsitem.headline: Austria's OMV to enter local gas market.

text.p: Austrian oil firm OMV said on Tuesday it was poised to bid for a stake in Burgenland holding company BEGAS-Gemeindee anteilsverwaltungs AG in order to gain a foothold in regional gas supplier BEGAS.

Chief executive Richard Schenz told a news conference OMV would submit a bid in the next few days for a 49 percent stake in GAV, a holding company representing 73 Burgenland communities with a 51.86 percent in local gas firm BEGAS.
Schenz expected that OMV's stake would shrink to 39 percent, however, with the remaining 10 percent going to BEGAS.
"This seems to be the preferred option in Burgenland," he said, adding he expected the deal to be in place by the end of May. -- Janet McBride, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
